registry.name: restore
registry.description: Open and place every window in the workspace plan.

registry.name: claude-sessions
registry.description: Resume Claude sessions the last shutdown cut off; start `claude` in empty terminals.

registry.name: chrome-organise
registry.description: Close merged, duplicate and superseded Chrome tabs, and group the rest, once idle.

registry.name: align
registry.description: Put open plan windows back on their desktop and slot, launching nothing.

registry.name: estate-sync
registry.description: `git fetch --prune` across every clone in the estate, so later checks see gone branches.

registry.name: estate-risk
registry.description: Report clones across the estate holding uncommitted or unpushed work.

registry.name: estate-trim
registry.description: Delete node_modules, venvs and build output in estate worktrees idle 7+ days.

registry.name: estate-orca
registry.description: Register every cloned managed project in the personal Orca, in its group.

registry.name: orca-sync
registry.description: Apply config/orca.json to the personal Orca: agent default args, repo colours, scripts, refs.

registry.name: otel-collector
registry.description: Keep the local OTel collector listening on 127.0.0.1:4317/4318; prune its files past 7 days.

registry.name: estate-prune-caches
registry.description: Prune the uv, pnpm, NuGet http and Docker build caches, and Claude temp idle 7+ days.

registry.name: worktree-reclaim
registry.description: Remove merged worktrees across every work repo (`workspace worktree reclaim`).

registry.name: estate-decisions
registry.description: Write the feed of worktrees and directories only a human can decide about.

registry.name: workspace-maintain
registry.description: The workspace repo's own due housekeeping (`workspace maintain run --due`).
